additional_info.body:
Dear Cenoiu Catalin George,
We have reviewed the router configuration for both chargers, and it is correctly set up. The WebSocket ping interval is configured at 30 seconds.
However, we have noticed that the OCPP connection is toggling approximately every 10 seconds. This suggests there may be a connectivity issue with your OCPP backend.
Could you please check with your OCPP backend provider to investigate this further?
With best regards,

no network connection
